source_name: Singapore Residents by Planning Area / Subzone, Age Group, Sex and Type of Dwelling, June 2026
source_notes: (Total) Resident Population by Planning Area/Subzone, Age Group and Type of Dwelling, June 2026
Planning areas refer to areas demarcated in the Urban Redevelopment Authority's Master Plan 2025.
Data from 2003 onwards excludes residents who have been away from Singapore for a continuous period of 12 months or longer as at the reference period.
Data has been rounded to the nearest 10 and may not add up due to rounding.
^ Includes non-privatised Housing and Urban Development Company (HUDC) flats.
* Includes HDB studio apartments and Community Care Apartments.
selection: 2026(Total) sheet; Subzone=Total, Age Group=Total, Type of Dwelling=Total; national Total excluded
missing_policy: Nonnumeric source cells remain null, including '-'; no zero filling or summing rounded detail cells.
catalogue_note: Current planning-area totals were verified at SingStat's primary publisher page; data.gov.sg catalogue searches returned historical Census tables and an annual region-level table, not this 2026 planning-area workbook.
